name: Inverse Finance
description: DAO behind the DOLA stablecoin and FiRM, a fixed-rate CDP on Ethereum: deposit collateral into a per-collateral market, borrow DOLA, and pay interest by holding DBR (burned at 1 DBR per DOLA borrowed per year). Agents can also stake DOLA as sDOLA, INV as sINV, or provide first-loss cover with jrDOLA.

Transfer DOLA.
Spendable DBR (18 decimals) after subtracting what open FiRM debt has consumed (1 DBR per 1 DOLA of debt per year, accrued per second). Returns 0 when in deficit.
DBR owed beyond the balance. If > 0 the user cannot borrow more or withdraw collateral, and anyone can forceReplenish them (adding DOLA debt at the replenishment price, ~54.75% APR per the docs).
Balance minus accrued burn as a signed int (negative = deficit).
User's total DOLA debt across all FiRM markets (drives the DBR burn rate).

Transfer DBR (e.g. top up a borrower's wallet). DBR is bought on the DBR auction (inverse.finance/dbr/auction) or on DEXs such as the Curve triDBR pool.

Mint an exact number of shares: (shares, receiver).
Burn shares for DOLA: (shares, receiver, owner). Instant, no queue. Reverts if it would leave fewer than MIN_SHARES (1e18) or less than 0.01 DOLA in the vault.
Withdraw an exact DOLA amount: (assets, receiver, owner).

Deposit INV (approve sINV first): (assets, receiver). Note: INV in sINV loses on-chain governance voting rights.

Deposit collateral (approve the market for the collateral token first; amount in the collateral's decimals). Collateral goes to your personal escrow contract, created on first deposit.

Borrow DOLA (18 decimals) to msg.sender. Requires: no DBR deficit (DBR.deficitOf == 0), debt <= getCreditLimit, borrows not paused, market daily limit and minimum debt in BorrowController, fresh oracle price, and msg.sender == tx.origin unless the calling contract is allowlisted. While debt is open, DBR in your wallet is burned at 1 DBR per 1 DOLA of debt per year - that is the interest. Hold enough DBR for the planned loan duration.
Repay DOLA debt for a user: (user, amount). Approve DOLA to the market first. Pass 2^256-1 to repay the full debt. Repaying stops further DBR burn on that amount.

Withdraw collateral from your escrow to msg.sender. Fails if it exceeds getWithdrawalLimit or if you have a DBR deficit.

DOLA already borrowed from a market on a day: (market, block.timestamp / 86400).

True if a smart contract may borrow; contracts not on the list are denied (EOAs always pass this check).

(collateralToken, collateralFactorBps) -> DOLA price of 1 whole collateral token scaled by 10^(36 - tokenDecimals) (1e18 for an 18-decimal token). Pessimistic: if the lower of today's and yesterday's daily low implies less borrowing power than spot, it returns a dampened price below spot. Passing collateralFactorBps = 0 returns the plain Chainlink-based price.

contracts.name: FiRM Fed (mints DOLA supply into FiRM)

actions.name: borrow-dola
actions.description: Open a fixed-rate DOLA loan on FiRM
actions.how: 1) Get DBR >= expected debt x years (DBR auction at inverse.finance/dbr/auction or Curve triDBR). 2) collateral.approve(market, amt). 3) market.depositAndBorrow(amt, dolaAmount) or deposit() then borrow(). Check market.getCreditLimit(you), market.borrowPaused(), BorrowController.dailyLimits/minDebts first. Must be sent by an EOA unless your contract is allowlisted.

actions.name: repay-and-withdraw
actions.description: Close or reduce a FiRM loan
actions.how: DOLA.approve(market, amt); market.repay(you, amt) (2^256-1 = all) then market.withdraw(collateralAmt), or market.repayAndWithdraw(repay, withdraw). Make sure DBR.deficitOf(you) == 0 or withdraw reverts.

actions.name: monitor-position
actions.how: market.debts(you), market.getCreditLimit(you), market.getWithdrawalLimit(you); DBR.balanceOf(you) / DBR.debts(you) = years of DBR left; DBR.deficitOf(you) must stay 0.

actions.name: stake-dola
actions.description: Earn yield on DOLA with sDOLA
actions.how: DOLA.approve(sDOLA, amt); sDOLA.deposit(amt, receiver). Exit any time with sDOLA.redeem(shares, receiver, owner).

actions.name: stake-inv
actions.how: INV.approve(sINV, amt); sINV.deposit(amt, receiver); exit with sINV.redeem(shares, receiver, owner). sINV holders do not vote on-chain.

actions.name: liquidate-or-replenish
actions.how: If market.debts(u) > market.getCreditLimit(u): DOLA.approve(market) then market.liquidate(u, repaid). If DBR.deficitOf(u) > 0: market.forceReplenish(u, amount) (or forceReplenishAll(u)) to earn the replenishment incentive.

risks: DBR is consumed continuously while debt is open; if it runs out, the position goes into deficit, cannot withdraw or borrow, and anyone can force-replenish it at a penalty rate (54.75% APR per docs) that is added to DOLA debt, which can lead to liquidation.

FiRM uses a pessimistic oracle (lowest recent ~48h price) so borrowing power lags price rises; borrows are also denied when the Chainlink feed is stale, when the market's daily borrow limit is hit, or below the minimum debt.
Smart contracts (including smart wallets) can only borrow if allowlisted in the BorrowController; EOAs are always allowed.

The INV market has new borrows paused (mill 389). Nine markets were sunset by mill 395 (2026-08-03): borrows paused and Fed ceiling zero; existing borrowers can still repay and withdraw (addresses on the docs page).
Governance (Governor Mills / INV holders) sets collateral factors, limits and oracles; guardian multisigs can pause markets and cancel proposals but not unpause.
DOLA peg risk: DOLA supply is managed by Feds (FiRM Fed, PSM Fed and others); sDOLA and jrDOLA values depend on DOLA holding $1.
jrDOLA is a first-loss tranche: deposits can be slashed to cover FiRM bad debt, withdrawals are time-delayed, and governance can pause withdrawals for up to 90 days (mill 390).
Cross-chain sDOLA (mill 396, 2026-08-11) and sINV (mill 393, 2026-07-21) CCIP lanes are shut down; L2 copies are historical and not bridge destinations.
Past incident (2 Apr 2022): oracle manipulation of the INV price on the legacy Anchor/Frontier money market let an attacker borrow ~$15.6M.

Past incident (16 Jun 2022): flash-loan manipulation of the yvCrv3Crypto LP price on Frontier caused ~$5.8M of bad debt (attacker profit ~$1.2M). Frontier borrowing is paused; FiRM replaced it with isolated escrows and the pessimistic oracle.
notes: All addresses are from the official docs Smart Contracts page (active markets as of October 2026) and were confirmed on-chain on 2026-11-25: each market's collateral(), oracle(), borrowController() and dbr() match the docs, sDOLA.asset() = DOLA, sINV.asset() = INV, jrDOLA.asset() = sDOLA. Market keyFunctions are listed once on the WETH market and come from InverseFinance/FiRM src/Market.sol; all 19 active markets share that interface (selectors checked in bytecode), except withdrawMax() which only exists on newer markets. sDOLA functions come from InverseFinance/dola-savings src/sDola.sol. Left out: the nine sunset FiRM markets (repay/withdraw only, listed on the docs page), historical L2 sDOLA/sINV deployments (CCIP lanes closed), the PSM and PSM Fed (docs list them on the PSM page, but I did not review the PSM source for its function signatures), the DBR auction, ALE/helper contracts and the legacy Frontier contracts, whose addresses are not on the official contracts page. jrDOLA's queued-withdrawal functions are not listed because I could not find its verified source in the official GitHub; use the inverse.finance app or check the verified source before redeeming. DefiLlama tracks FiRM separately as inverse-finance-firm.
